intended_object: A bijection, used in the proofs of this file, between the periodic flags of a relative transition system unglued from the closed glued fragment and the periodic flags of the original system on the glued fragment. Inferred from the docstring and from where it sits in the skein/glue transport file.
explanation: This is a technical device, not a mathematical notion from the literature. It is an `Equiv` between two subtypes, and it only re-wraps values. In one direction it sends a flag `f` to the same flag viewed as a `SurvivingFlag` (a flag of the glued fragment). In the other it sends `g` back to its underlying flag `g.val.val`. The membership proofs come from lemmas in the library: `periodicFlags_of_val_glueClosed`, `periodicFlags_val_of_glueClosed` and `internal_surviving`. Both inverse laws hold by `rfl` on the underlying values. Its only role is to move cardinalities or sums between the two sides of the gluing construction in the library's own setup of fragments and transition systems. There is no standard mathematical object here to compare it with.
